description:
¿Quiénes somos? 




At NUBA, we believe travel is an art.




"The Art of Travel" es mucho más que nuestro tagline; es la forma en que entendemos cada experiencia que creamos. Diseñamos viajes extraordinarios con sensibilidad, excelencia y atención al detalle, transformando ideas y sueños en historias que permanecen en el tiempo.




Somos líderes en la creación de viajes de lujo y experiencias personalizadas en el sector hispanoparlante. Nuestro propósito es inspirar una forma de viajar con intención, generando conexiones auténticas entre las personas, los destinos y las experiencias que marcan una vida.




Detrás de cada experiencia NUBA existe un equipo apasionado que comparte una misma visión: elevar cada detalle para crear algo verdaderamente excepcional.




Hoy buscamos personas que quieran formar parte de esta historia y contribuir con su talento a seguir reinventando el arte de viajar.




The Art of Travel starts with extraordinary people.




Conoce más sobre nosotros en https://nuba.com/




Propósito de Design Intern




Apoyar al equipo de Diseño en la creación y adaptación de materiales visuales para proyectos de comunicación, marketing, eventos y comunicación interna, contribuyendo a mantener la identidad visual de la marca y a desarrollar contenidos que comuniquen experiencias de viaje de manera creativa y estratégica.




Esta posición te permitirá involucrarte en proyectos reales, conocer diferentes áreas de la compañía y desarrollar tanto tus habilidades técnicas como tu criterio creativo, acompañado/a de mentoría y retroalimentación constante.




¿Cuáles serán tus principales funciones?




Construcción y cuidado de marca

Participar en el desarrollo de materiales alineados con la identidad visual de la marca.
Adaptar campañas, promociones y contenidos para diferentes destinos, temporadas y experiencias.




Edición de fotografía y contenido audiovisual

Retocar y optimizar imágenes de hoteles, destinos y experiencias de viaje.
Crear presentaciones visuales y videos cortos para iniciativas de marketing y comunicación.




Diseño editorial e impreso

Diseñar brochures, flyers, presentaciones y materiales promocionales.
Colaborar en el desarrollo de piezas para eventos, ferias y presentaciones corporativas.




Proyectos creativos

Trabajar de manera colaborativa con equipos de PR, Ventas y Digital.
Aportar ideas, conceptos y soluciones visuales en sesiones creativas y campañas especiales.
Creación de materiales para diferentes áreas
Desarrollar recursos gráficos para proyectos internos y externos.
Crear materiales adaptados a las necesidades de diferentes equipos.




Contenido y copywriting

Participar en la redacción y adaptación de textos para diferentes formatos y canales.
Utilizar herramientas de Inteligencia Artificial, como ChatGPT, para potenciar la generación y adaptación de contenido.




Comunicación interna

Diseñar comunicados y materiales para diferentes áreas.
Contribuir al fortalecimiento de la cultura y comunicación interna a través del diseño.




Eventos y experiencias de marca

Colaborar en la organización y ejecución de eventos y experiencias especiales.
Brindar seguimiento y apoyo operativo en momentos clave.




¿Qué buscamos en ti?




Estudiante de 7.º u 8.º semestre de Diseño, Artes Visuales, Comunicación Visual o carreras afines.
Manejo de Canva (indispensable).
Interés por el diseño gráfico, contenido visual y comunicación.
Creatividad y atención al detalle.
Proactividad y disposición para aprender.
Capacidad para trabajar de manera colaborativa.
Interés por el mundo de los viajes y experiencias de lujo.
Gusto por explorar nuevas herramientas y tendencias de diseño y contenido.




¿Qué encontrarás en NUBA?




Más que un empleo, encontrarás la oportunidad de formar parte de una organización donde las personas son quienes hacen posible el arte de viajar.




Serás parte de:




Un equipo apasionado por crear experiencias extraordinarias.
Una cultura basada en la excelencia, la confianza y la innovación.
Un entorno que impulsa el aprendizaje, el crecimiento y el desarrollo profesional.
Una organización que valora las ideas, la colaboración y la iniciativa.
Una empresa comprometida con la sostenibilidad, la diversidad y la inclusión.
Una experiencia laboral diseñada para que cada persona pueda desarrollar su máximo potencial.




Porque, así como cuidamos cada detalle de los viajes que diseñamos, también cuidamos la experiencia de quienes construyen NUBA cada día.




The Art of Travel. The Art of Growing Together.




NUBA promueve una política transparente de atracción, selección y contratación, que garantice igualdad de oportunidades a candidatos, sin hacer ninguna exclusión por motivos de sexo, edad, raza u otra condición no relacionada con el buen desempeño del puesto que se busca cubrir.

description:
Job Description



Descripción

¿Te apasiona el análisis de datos y la toma de decisiones estratégicas?



 ¡Entonces este es el lugar para ti! En nuestro equipo, estarás en contacto directo con clientes de grandes marcas de consumo masivo, apoyándolos con recomendaciones basadas en datos e información estratégica. Nuestra área se enfoca en el análisis de paneles de hogares, donde monitoreamos los hábitos de compra de los consumidores y las tendencias del mercado. ¡Serás parte de un equipo que trabaja con datos reales, ayudando a grandes marcas a entender su desempeño y la competencia!



 



Responsabilidades

Como parte del equipo, tu rol será clave para garantizar que nuestros clientes reciban información clara, precisa y útil. Algunas de tus tareas serán:



Soporte Administrativo: Colaborar con el equipo de panel de hogares, subiendo tickets y gestionando el seguimiento de solicitudes con el equipo de operaciones
Análisis de Datos: Extraer y organizar información para crear reportes sencillos y complejos (en Excel y PowerPoint). Aprenderás a realizar análisis detallados que se entregarán a los clientes
Entregables a Clientes: Apoyo en la creación de presentaciones e informes, tanto periódicos como puntuales, con insights clave sobre el comportamiento de los consumidores y las estrategias del mercado
Interacción con el Cliente: Colaboración en la elaboración de entregables que se utilizan para guiar las decisiones de negocio


Qualifications



Perfil Ideal



Estudiantes que se gradúen entre Julio y Septiembre de carreras económicas o afines con interés en análisis de datos y marketing (Marketing, Relaciones Comerciales, Ingeniería Industrial, Matemáticas, Actuaría, etc.)
Disponibilidad de medio tiempo (puede ser en turnos matutinos o vespertinos)
Habilidades de análisis: Te apasiona descubrir patrones y tendencias a partir de datos
Habilidades de comunicación: Te gusta transmitir información de manera clara y efectiva
Conocimientos de Excel: Intermedio o avanzado (fórmulas, tablas dinámicas y análisis de datos)
PowerPoint Intermedio: Para crear presentaciones atractivas y efectivas
Inglés Intermedio: Capacidad para manejar documentación básica y colaborar con equipos internacionales

Lo que te ofrecemos



Trabajo híbrido: Disfruta de la flexibilidad de trabajar desde casa 3 días a la semana
Desarrollo profesional: Aprenderás de un equipo experto y tendrás acceso a recursos para seguir perfeccionando tus habilidades en análisis y marketing
Ambiente dinámico: Un entorno colaborativo y lleno de retos que te permitirá poner en práctica lo que aprendes en tu carrera
Crecimiento: Oportunidades de desarrollo y la posibilidad de integrarte a proyectos clave con grandes marcas


Additional Information



As part of our recruitment process, NielsenIQ (NIQ) may use a trusted third-party AI-enabled technology provider, Spotted Zebra Solutions Ltd, to support the assessment of candidates. These tools ingest categories of personal information including your CV/resume content, application data, responses to assessment questions and interview responses, and help us evaluate information relevant to the recruitment process, such as skills, competencies, interview responses, assessment results and role suitability. They may generate recommendations or summaries to support recruiters and hiring managers. In some cases, you may interact directly with an AI-enabled tool during the interview or assessment process. 



 



The purpose of these tools is to improve the consistency, efficiency and quality of our recruitment process. The outputs generated are reviewed by authorized NIQ recruiters and hiring managers and are used alongside other relevant information as part of the overall recruitment process. 

Please note: recruiting decisions will be made by recruiting and hiring teams only.  



 



If you would like to request an additional human review, share your point of view, or contest a decision, you can contact us at privacy.ta@nielseniq.com. For more information, please see NIQ’s Applicant Privacy Statement.



Our Benefits



Flexible working environment
Volunteer time off
LinkedIn Learning
Employee-Assistance-Program (EAP)

NIQ may utilize artificial intelligence (AI) tools at various stages of the recruitment process, including résumé screening, candidate assessments, interview scheduling, job matching, communication support, and certain administrative tasks that help streamline workflows. These tools are intended to improve efficiency and support fair and consistent evaluation based on job-related criteria. All use of AI is governed by NIQ’s principles of fairness, transparency, human oversight, and inclusion. Final hiring decisions are made exclusively by humans. NIQ regularly reviews its AI tools to help mitigate bias and ensure compliance with applicable laws and regulations. If you have questions, require accommodations, or wish to request human review were permitted by law, please contact your local HR representative. For more information, please visit NIQ’s AI Safety Policies and Guiding Principles: https://nielseniq.com/global/en/info/niqs-ai-safety-policies/






About NIQ



NIQ is the world’s leading consumer intelligence company, delivering the most complete understanding of consumer buying behavior and revealing new pathways to growth. In 2023, NIQ combined with GfK, bringing together the two industry leaders with unparalleled global reach. With a holistic retail read and the most comprehensive consumer insights—delivered with advanced analytics through state-of-the-art platforms—NIQ delivers the Full View™. NIQ is an Advent International portfolio company with operations in 100+ markets, covering more than 90% of the world’s population.



For more information, visit NIQ.com



Want to keep up with our latest updates?



Follow us on: LinkedIn | Instagram | Twitter | Facebook






Our commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion



At NIQ, we are steadfast in our commitment to fostering an inclusive workplace that mirrors the rich diversity of the communities and markets we serve. We believe that embracing a wide range of perspectives drives innovation and excellence.  All employment decisions at NIQ are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws. We invite individuals who share our dedication to inclusivity and equity to join us in making a meaningful impact. To learn more about our ongoing efforts in diversity and inclusion, please visit the https://nielseniq.com/global/en/news-center/diversity-inclusion

title: Creator Incubation Project Intern (TikTok Shop - Mexico Operation) - 2026 Start (BS/MS)
skills: Assist in empowering and incubating high-potential e-commerce creators by providing daily support, guidance, and encouragement on content production techniques.
Actively communicate and build strong, trust-based relationships with creators and agency hosts, ensuring they feel supported and motivated to achieve their sales goals.
Support the team in matching curated product assortments with the right creators, helping to brainstorm and co-create engaging e-commerce content (short videos & livestreams).
Help organize and facilitate training sessions for livestream hosts, assisting them in understanding livestreaming tools, refining on-camera scripts, and improving viewer interaction.
Assist in tracking and analyzing post-livestream data. Help translate these data insights into easy-to-understand, actionable advice that creators can use to optimize their future sessions.
Guide creators to maintain high-quality content standards and adhere to platform guidelines, fostering a healthy e-commerce ecosystem.
Currently pursuing an Undergraduate/Master in Business or a related fields
Strong skills in interpersonal and communication; you are a "people person" who genuinely enjoys interacting, listening, and building rapport with diverse individuals.
Proactive fast-learner, open to navigating uncertain and exploratory business scenarios.
Applicants are kindly requested to submit an English-language resume.
Proven skills in analytical with a willingness to learn how to use data to formulate actionable strategies.
Strong analytical skills, with a structured and critical approach to problem-solving;
Experience in TikTok platform, short-form video trends, and the livestreaming e-commerce ecosystem.
description:
Responsibilities

Team Introduction

The e-commerce industry has grown tremendously recently, becoming a hotly contested space among leading Internet companies. Its future growth cannot be underestimated.

With millions of loyal users globally, we believe TikTok is an ideal platform to deliver a brand new and better e-commerce experience to our users. We are looking for passionate and talented people to join our campaign team. Together, we can build an e-commerce ecosystem that is innovative, secure, and intuitive for our users.

Step into a dynamic role with the Mexico operation team, where you'll play a vital part in executing varies campaigns for some of the most iconic brands. Be at the forefront of innovation, contributing to cutting-edge campaigns and driving forward the yearly strategic modules that define success. title: Growth Marketing Coordinator (Lifecycle & Outbound)
description:
About Us

MEDLIFE is a non-profit organization that partners with low-income communities in Latin America and Africa to improve their access to medicine, education, and community development projects.

Our mission

is to build a worldwide Movement empowering the poor in their fight for equal access to healthcare, education, and a safe home.

Our vision

is a world free from the constraints of poverty. MEDLIFE works with students from around the world in order to broaden their perspectives and better equip them to advocate for social justice.

Our ideal Growth Marketing Coordinator (Lifecycle & Outbound)

We're looking for a growth marketer who knows how to start new relationships and how to deepen existing ones. You have run cold email and outbound campaigns at real scale, and you have built lifecycle journeys that turned first-time customers into repeat ones. You value proof over activity: you can speak to the numbers behind your work, including volumes, reply rates, retention, and what you changed after a test. As we continue growing, we'd love for you to be part of the MEDLIFE Movement.

About The Role

You will build and own MEDLIFE's email- and CRM-driven growth engine across the full participant journey. On the acquisition side, you will identify and reach high-potential U.S. college students through outbound and cold email, generating qualified conversations that grow MEDLIFE's Student Leadership Teams and chapter network. On the retention side, you will own the journey after the first conversion, building nurture, repurchase, and reactivation journeys in HubSpot that turn participants into repeat travelers, chapter leaders, and lifelong alumni advocates.

This is an individual contributor position with end-to-end ownership of outbound and lifecycle outcomes, and a clear path to a Lead role as the function grows. You will report to the Head of Marketing and work closely with the Expansion, Sales, Customer Success, RevOps, and Data Solutions teams.

What will your day-to-day look like at MEDLIFE?

Identify universities, student organizations, and individual students most likely to become MEDLIFE leaders, and build targeted prospect lists and ICPs.

Source, verify, and maintain clean prospect data in HubSpot, using enrichment tools and AI.

Manage sending infrastructure and deliverability (SPF, DKIM, DMARC, warm-up, sending volume), protecting MEDLIFE's sender reputation.

Write and test cold email sequences for different student personas, in line with CAN-SPAM and other applicable compliance practices.

Map the full participant journey, from first contact through participation, chapter leadership, graduation, and alumni advocacy.

Build segmented nurture, repurchase, and reactivation journeys in HubSpot based on behavior, lifecycle stage, program history, and inactivity.

Run multichannel campaigns (email, SMS/WhatsApp, myMEDLIFE, social retargeting) focused on relevant next actions, not message volume.

Partner with Expansion, Sales, and Customer Success on clear handoffs between automated outreach and human follow-up.

Track conversion, deliverability, reactivation, LTV, and revenue influenced, and keep improving targeting, segmentation, and messaging.

What will you bring?

Minimum 4 years of combined growth marketing experience, including at least 2 years in lifecycle, retention, or CRM marketing and at least 2 years running cold email or outbound campaigns (or equivalent hands-on experience across both), with a focus on U.S. and/or Canadian audiences.

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, Data/Growth Analytics, or a related field; hands-on experience takes precedence over formal credentials.

Proven ownership of retention, repurchase, reactivation, or LTV outcomes through segmented, multi-stage journeys.

Cold email at meaningful scale (not small-batch or newsletter-level sending), with testing and iteration based on real results.

Hands-on deliverability experience: SPF, DKIM, DMARC, warm-up, domain reputation, and bounce management.

Hands-on HubSpot experience (strongly preferred) and working knowledge of Clay, Apollo, or an equivalent prospecting/enrichment platform.

Strong segmentation, experimentation, cohort analysis, and funnel-measurement skills.

Demonstrated use of AI tools or agents for research, personalization, or campaign execution in a real workflow.

Persuasive, natural copywriting for North American audiences, tested against real response data.

Advanced / professional working proficiency in English.

Nice To Have

Experience recruiting or marketing to students, universities, Gen Z audiences, education, travel, or nonprofit programs.

Experience building cross-stage journeys (e.g., prospect to participant to alumni) or referral/advocacy programs.

Experience with WhatsApp/SMS, multichannel CRM, and working across North America and LATAM teams.

What do we offer you?

Full-time, 100% remote position for candidates based in Latin America, Monday to Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. (GMT-5).

Competitive salary commensurate with the role, a competitive benefits package, and your birthday off.

End-to-end ownership of outbound and lifecycle growth, with a growth path to a Lead role as the team expands.

Mission-driven work that directly supports MEDLIFE's ability to serve more students and communities.

description:
Company Description

At Docplanner Group, we’re on a mission to help people live longer, healthier lives. As the world’s largest healthcare platform, each month, we connect 24 million patients with 280k doctors across 13 countries (through brands like ZnanyLekarz, Doctoralia, MioDottore, DoktorTakvimi, and jameda). Our marketplaces, SaaS and AI tools simplify daily tasks and help doctors, clinics and hospitals work more efficiently, so they can focus on what really matters: caring for their patients.

Learn more about our products here: pro.doctoralia.es

Why join us?

📊 Real impact – We help doctors help patients. Your work truly makes a difference.

📈 At scale, yet agile – 3,000+ employees, but still fast, flexible, and hands-on.

✨ Shape the future, sustain growth – Make a difference now and build for long-term success.

Job Description

As our AI Native Marketer, you own acquisition for Noa Notes: everything from the first time a doctor sees Noa to the moment they sign up and start their first session. That means ads and creatives, landing pages and the pitch on them, emails to our own database of doctors, newsletters, partners and new channels. You are a 360 marketer, not a paid-ads specialist.

Cheap sign-ups are not the goal. Doctors should arrive educated and motivated, knowing what Noa does and ready to try it. We judge acquisition quality by what happens in their first session. Onboarding, activation and conversion to paid stay with product, and you work closely with them. You own the number (quality sign-ups at a CAC we can scale); channels are your choice.

We're looking for a hands-on growth marketer who has owned an acquisition number and built the machine behind it. Think of how the fastest-growing AI apps run growth: one person with agents doing what used to take a team. Specifically, someone who:


Builds, not just manages. You build your own AI workflows and agents to produce content, launch campaigns, coordinate suppliers, and buy media at a volume a traditional team can't match.
Treats SaaS ads like e-commerce. Lots of creatives, fast tests, creative as the targeting, hard CAC discipline, measured on quality, not only volume.
Sets up tracking before spending. No euro goes out until we can tie it to a sign-up and what that doctor did next
Has creative taste. You know what makes a hook stop the scroll and you care about craft.
Gets to new channels early. Creators, newsletters, and getting Noa cited by AI assistants such as ChatGPT and Perplexity.


How will you make an impact?

Yes, it’s a lot. We believe one person with the right AI setup can now do what used to take a team, and you’ll take it over step by step.

Ads & Creative


Produce a high volume of creatives every week: UGC-style videos, doctor testimonials, demos of Noa writing a note live, static ads, carousels.
Use AI tools (Claude, image, video and voice generation, editing tools) to go from idea to live ad in hours, not weeks.
Launch and run paid campaigns on Meta, Google (Search, YouTube, PMax), TikTok and LinkedIn, e-commerce style: broad targeting, creative as the targeting.


Landing Pages & Pitch


Own the Noa web pages and landing pages: the pitch, the copy and the sub-pages for each specialty, country and use case, so doctors arrive knowing what Noa does and why it’s worth trying today.
Build and A/B test landing pages and sign-up flows for every campaign, in the languages of our markets.


Email & Our Own Database


Turn the ~500K doctors on Docplanner marketplaces into Noa users with email, in-product and WhatsApp campaigns, segmented by specialty and country.
Build nurture flows for doctors who visited or signed up but never started their first session.


Partners & New Channels (partially supported by the broader marketing team)


Launch affiliates/referrals, newsletter sponsorships, medical communities, podcasts and partnerships with medical associations, universities and congresses.
Run creator and doctor-influencer programmes.
Make Noa the answer when doctors ask ChatGPT, Perplexity or Gemini for an AI scribe or a clinical question, and build SEO content from Evidence.


Measure & Improve every week


Set up tracking before spending: pixels, conversion API, UTMs and events into Amplitude and HubSpot, so every channel is tied to sign-ups, first-session activity and, later, paying doctors.
Run a weekly test cadence across channels, pages and messages; kill losers fast, scale winners.
Report cost per sign-up and sign-up quality (first-session activity) by country and channel, and work with product on what happens next.


Build your own machine


Automate content production, campaign set-up, emails, sponsorship buying and reporting with agents and no-code tools, so a team of one moves like a team of five.


Who You Are

We’re looking for someone with 2 years in growth, performance or lifecycle marketing, at a startup, an agency or on your own projects. You’ve owned a number and moved it. We care more about what you’ve built and how fast you learn than about your CV.

Must-haves


You’ve owned an acquisition number (CAC, sign-ups, paying users), even at small scale, and improved it: first results, then iteration. Bring numbers.
You’ve run paid campaigns on Meta and/or Google with real money (a few thousand euros a month is fine) and tested creatives at volume.
You build with AI every day: image, video and voice tools, Claude, automations. Show us something you made.
Creative taste: you can write a hook that stops the scroll and tell a good ad from a bad one.
Comfortable with numbers: you want to know which channel brings what quality, and what it cost.
Fluent English. Spanish or Portuguese is a strong plus.


Nice-to-haves


You’ve set up tracking: pixels, conversion API, UTMs, GA4/Amplitude.
You’ve built a landing page yourself (Webflow, Framer or code).
You’ve written email campaigns or nurture flows (HubSpot, Mailchimp or similar).
You’ve run an affiliate, referral or creator programme (even a small one), or made UGC-style content yourself.
Interest in healthcare or in selling to professionals such as doctors.


How You Work


High energy and bias to shipping: ten small tests beat one perfect plan.
Scale what works: push budget fast on winners, find the ceiling, fix what broke.
Quality over volume: you’d rather bring 100 doctors who use Noa than 1,000 who never open it.
You own the number and say when something is not working.
You care about doctors and respect that this is healthcare: claims are accurate and patient data is protected.


What To Expect From Our Hiring Process

We like to keep things transparent and efficient! Here’s what the process usually looks like (though it might vary slightly depending on the role):

1️⃣ Intro Chat – A first call with our Talent Partner Giuliana, to explore mutual fit around relevant skills, value alignment, and motivation.

2️⃣ Interview – A deeper conversation about your background, aspirations, and AI experience with Gerard, Chief of Staff for AI Solutions. Take this chance to ask anything on your mind - it’s just as much about making sure we’re the right fit for you, too.

3️⃣Additional Interview - Another deeper conversation about Marketing with Marta, our CMO.

4️⃣Business Case – A take-home exercise incl. a few days' preparation time, designed to understand how you approach real-life problems. You’ll then walk us through your approach in a collaborative discussion with the team to discuss your thoughts and findings.

5️⃣ Final Interview – A final conversation with Karol, VP of AI Solutions.

6️⃣ References & Offer!

Why You’ll Love It Here

💙 Global Benefits – No matter where you are, you’ll have access to:


Healthcare insurance – so you can focus on what matters.
Wellness that works for you – from gym memberships to mental health support, we’ve got you covered.
Time off that counts – whether it’s a vacation, your birthday, or just a day to recharge, we believe in balance.


📍 Local Perks – Depending on your location, you will be entitled to local benefits like meal vouchers (ticket restaurant), transport allowances, or extended parental leave.

🚀 Career Growth – We’re growing, and so can you! You’ll find lots of chances to learn, develop, and explore new paths—whether within your team or through cross-functional projects.

🌎 A Truly Global Team – Work with talented people from all over the world in a diverse and inclusive environment.

⏳ Flexibility That Works for You – Remote work and flexible hours aren’t just buzzwords here. While the extent of flexibility depends on your role and team, we value results over rigid schedules. Prefer an office setting? You're welcome at any of our hubs in Barcelona, Warsaw, Curitiba, Rio de Janeiro, Mexico City, Bogotá, Munich, Rome or Bologna.

Please note: At this time, we are not able to sponsor visas for this position. To apply, you must already have the legal right to work in your country of residence or the location of the role.

What We Believe In

At Docplanner, our values guide everything we do:

📊 Focus on results – we're here to make an impact.

🧠 Think like an owner – take responsibility, drive outcomes.

✂️ Keep it simple, keep it lean – smart solutions over complexity.

🔊 Be respectful and radically honest – openness builds trust.

About Four Seasons

Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world-class employee experience and company culture.

At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.

About the location:

An urban oasis in the heart of the city. Set around a verdant inner courtyard, our hacienda-style Hotel puts the hectic urban hustle of Mexico’s vibrant capital city seemingly on pause, but only for as long as you’d like. Step outside our doors, and you’ll find yourself on the grand boulevard of Paseo de la Reforma, just a short stroll away from Bosque de Chapultepec and the trendy neighbourhoods of Condesa and Polanco. Want to know what makes Mexico City tick? Join us at Fifty Mils, one of the 50 Best Bars of the world, and taste the cocktails that are captivating Mexico City.

Únete a nuestro equipo diverso y talentoso de Four Seasons Hotel Ciudad de México,   

Construido en torno a un idílico jardín con rayos de luz que permite que se refleje el brillo de los colores mexicanos, resaltando cada espacio que permiten un viaje de inspiración descubriendo como interactuar con la naturaleza poniendo en pausa al ruido, con una ubicación privilegiada, sobre el elegante Paseo de la Reforma y a metros del Bosque Chapultepec y del Museo de Arte Moderno. Acerca de Four Seasons Hotels & Resorts:  

Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts abrió su primer hotel en 1961 y su historia es una historia de innovación continua, expansión notable y una dedicación decidida a los más altos estándares. description:
Responsibilities
TikTok's Global Business Solutions (GBS) regional sales and advertising teams drive revenue growth by promoting our advertising solutions, onboarding clients, and running campaigns that deliver measurable results.

Client needs, market trends, and performance expectations shift constantly, and differently in every market. We build strategy accordingly, turning those moving pieces into advertising solutions that work and client partnerships that last.

You will help businesses grow on a global platform, working on the campaigns and relationships that turn advertisers into long-term partners.

The Industry Operations Client Solutions team formulates industry strategy and identifies growth opportunities, delivering industry-specific solutions and methodologies across the LATAM region. We nurture accounts through high-touch client service and education on TikTok solutions, supporting brands in achieving their marketing and business objectives. Cross-functional collaboration is a core pillar of the team, enabling holistic solutions that span product knowledge, vertical expertise, and market-level insights. We are looking for individuals with strong business acumen who can develop strategies and drive ads revenue growth for TikTok Shop (TTS) in a fast-paced environment.

Responsibilities
- Collaborate with the international e-commerce, advertising product, and sales teams to develop and execute ad strategies for promotional day campaigns, ensuring they run smoothly and deliver results
- Develop a deep understanding of the TikTok Shop ecosystem across industries, and provide data-driven business insights to top industry advertisers to formulate industry strategies and drive industry growth
- Work closely with the product team to drive the go-to-market (GTM) of new products, actively collect client feedback, and help optimize the performance of e-Commerce advertising products
- Provide strong support to the sales team by developing media investment plans and delivering marketing solution presentations for key TTS clients; Continuously serve advertising clients to help improve campaign performance and drive business growth
- Proactively identify incremental growth opportunities and turn them into reusable industry strategies

Qualifications
Minimum Qualification(s)
- Bachelor's degree or above; 
- Proficiency in English and Spanish (both written & verbal) due to working with stakeholders in both English & Spanish-Speaking markets
- 3+ years of experience in digital marketing, e-Commerce marketing, or advertising strategy, able to adapt to a fast-paced working environment
- Hands-on experience in brand and performance advertising, or experience at an advertising agency, with a solid understanding of at least one industry and the ability to turn that understanding into actionable insights and scale them up
- Solid data analytics skills with the ability to derive insights and evaluate campaign performance; proficient in Excel
- Familiarity with ad measurement tools and basic troubleshooting knowledge

About TikTok
TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.​


Why Join Us
Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.​
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.​
​
Diversity & Inclusion​
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.​


TikTok Accommodation
TikTok is committed to providing reasonable accommodations in our recruitment processes for candidates with disabilities, pregnancy, sincerely held religious beliefs or other reasons protected by applicable laws. Mantener la evidencia y trazabilidad de los envíos, documentando audiencias, versiones de contenido, aprobaciones y constancias de entrega junto con Martech y el Coordinador de Gobernanza, para responder a auditorías y requerimientos de autoridades.

Gestionar la relación con Lending, Riesgos y Finanzas, traduciendo las estrategias de originación/adquisición y gestión de portafolio en planes de comunicación, para alinear prioridades, capacidad y expectativas de resultados.

description:
Company Description

Continental desarrolla tecnologías y servicios vanguardistas para la movilidad sostenible e interconectada de personas y bienes. Fundada en 1871, la empresa de tecnología ofrece soluciones seguras, eficientes, inteligentes y asequibles para vehículos, máquinas, tráfico y transporte. En 2022, Continental generó ventas por 39 400 millones de euros y actualmente emplea a unas 200 000 personas en 57 países y mercados.

Con su cartera de productos de primera calidad en el segmento de llantas para automóviles, camiones, buses, vehículos de dos ruedas y especiales, el sector del grupo Llantas es sinónimo de soluciones innovadoras en el ámbito de la tecnología de las llantas. La cartera se completa con productos y servicios inteligentes relacionados con las llantas y la promoción de la sostenibilidad. Para los concesionarios especializados y la administración de flotas, el grupo Llantas ofrece sistemas digitales de monitoreo y gestión de llantas, además de otros servicios, con el objetivo de mantener las flotas en movimiento y mejorar su eficiencia. Con sus llantas, Continental contribuye significativamente a una movilidad segura, eficiente y respetuosa con el medioambiente.

Develop and execute comprehensive marketing strategies that drive brand awareness and directly support organizational business objectives
Lead the marketing department with accountability for team performance, strategic direction, and resource optimization

Identify and qualify potential customer segments to support lead generation and sales pipeline development
Coordinate all marketing projects from conception through completion, ensuring alignment with organizational goals

Develop comprehensive product and service offerings documentation for internal and external stakeholders

Bachelor´s degree in Marketing or related
Fluent level of English
At least 7 years of experience in Sales / Marketing
Previous experience managing teams
Desirable experience in Retail, Communication, Branding or related.

description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose-driven, world-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.

Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.

Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.

Propósito de la posición:

Es responsable de contribuir a la conexión del negocio con profesionales de la salud mediante el

desarrollo y ejecución de contenidos, comunicaciones, eventos y programas de marketing médico en México para las marcas OTC y Wellness/Oral Care de Haleon. Asimismo, apoya el desarrollo e implementación de materiales, herramientas y programas de capacitación que fortalezcan los conocimientos científicos y las habilidades comerciales del equipo de visita médica, facilitando la aplicación de la estrategia de las marcas en campo, con el objetivo de incrementar las recomendaciones de los profesionales de la salud y contribuir al crecimiento de las marcas competitiva de Haleon en el ecosistema eCommerce.

Principales responsabilidades:

Ejecutar las estrategias y los objetivos de Expert para las marcas de OTC/Oral Care, así

como las iniciativas de Capability asignadas, para contribuir al cumplimiento de los

objetivos de recomendación y KPIs establecidos.


 Gestionar en la herramienta correspondiente la revisión y aprobación del contenido y los



materiales de comunicación para los profesionales de la salud y las marcas de OTC/Oral

care. Dar seguimiento a las autorizaciones de contenido ante COFEPRIS, en coordinación

con Regulatorio.


 Coordinar y asegurar el cumplimiento del proceso de TPO y contratos con HCPs, HCOs y



proveedores indispensables para la ejecución de las actividades asignadas.


 Ejecutar de forma adecuada el presupuesto A&P asignado a las actividades del área y dar



seguimiento a los compromisos con los proveedores involucrados.


 Coordinar la ejecución y logística de los eventos asignados tanto de expert marketing



como de capacitación junto con la agencia correspondiente, así como mantener

actualizado el calendario y administrar los soportes requeridos de acuerdo con las políticas

vigentes.


 Entender los requerimientos de los profesionales de la salud —como médicos generales,



pediatras y odontólogos— para desarrollar y adaptar contenidos y materiales impresos y

digitales de comunicación relevantes y atractivos para ellos.

Tus calificaciones:

Licenciatura concluida en el área de la salud (Medicina, Farmacia, Química Farmacéutica Biológica, Odontología o afín), o en Mercadotecnia o áreas afines con experiencia en la industria farmacéutica o de salud de consumo en proyectos dirigidos a profesionales de la salud y visita médica.

Deseable formación complementaria en marketing farmacéutico, comunicación científica o capacitación. No se requiere especialidad médica ni posgrado.


 De 2 a 3 años de experiencia en la industria farmacéutica o de salud de consumo, en funciones relacionadas con marketing dirigido a profesionales de la salud, comunicación científica y capacitación médico-comercial.
 Experiencia en participación en proyectos y actividades dirigidas a profesionales de la salud y equipos de visita médica.

 Experiencia en desarrollo o adaptación de materiales dirigidos a profesionales de la salud y al equipo de visita médica, incluyendo seguimiento de su revisión y aprobación.
 Deseable experiencia en apoyo a la organización de eventos médicos o educativos, incluyendo logística y seguimiento a agencias o proveedores.

description:
Content Creation, Content Marketing, Creative Content Production, Design, Digital Marketing, Social Media, Social Media Marketing

Remote | Full-Time | Eastern Time Availability | C$12,000 Annually

Royal York Property Management is looking for a creative and highly organized professional to produce marketing content for residential rental properties.

You will take property details, photographs, and video clips and turn them into polished listings, improved images, virtually furnished rooms, and short videos that help available properties stand out.

This is a hands-on production position. It is not a senior marketing-strategy, social-media-management, or paid-advertising role.

Your Work

Property Positioning and Listings

You will identify each property’s strongest selling points, write engaging titles and descriptions, and publish accurate listings across approved rental websites and online platforms.

You will adjust content to meet different platform requirements and keep prices, availability, photographs, and property details current.

Photography and AI Editing

You will select the strongest property photographs and complete light editing such as cropping, resizing, lighting improvements, and appropriate cleanup.

When needed, you will use AI tools to remove temporary clutter or virtually furnish empty rooms.

AI may improve the presentation, but it must never change permanent property features, room dimensions, layouts, or amenities.

Short-Form Video Content

You will create short property videos using photographs and video clips.

You may also create AI-assisted content using presenters, avatars, or voiceovers.

Tools May Include


Canva
CapCut
HeyGen
AI virtual-staging platforms
AI object-removal tools
Comparable image and video applications


You will be responsible for reviewing AI-generated content and correcting visual, factual, pronunciation, or branding errors before publication.

Organization and Quality Control

You may manage content for several properties at the same time.

You Will Need To


Track every active listing and its current status
Complete urgent price and availability corrections
Remove or update properties that are no longer available
Manage competing deadlines
Identify missing information or materials
Coordinate with Royal York’s leasing and property-management teams
Respond professionally to feedback and complete revisions promptly


What You Should Bring

We Are Looking For Someone With


Two to three years of experience in digital marketing, content creation, online listings, real-estate marketing, marketplace content, or a comparable field
Experience producing online listings, graphics, edited photographs, or short videos
Strong writing skills and the ability to identify a property’s strongest selling points
Experience with Canva, CapCut, or comparable editing tools
Experience using AI for photo editing, object removal, virtual furnishing, or virtual staging
Experience with HeyGen or another AI presenter, avatar, voice, or video-generation tool
Strong creative and visual judgment
Excellent organization and attention to detail
The ability to manage multiple assignments and deadlines
The ability to receive feedback and revise work without becoming defensive
Strong written and spoken English
The ability to work independently
Reliable internet, a suitable computer, and a professional remote-work environment
Full-time availability with regular overlap during Eastern Time business hours


Candidates with less experience may be considered when their portfolio demonstrates strong ability.

Experience in residential leasing, property management, PropTech, real estate, or property-listing platforms is preferred but not required.

A Bachelor’s degree is not required. Your demonstrated ability, relevant experience, and portfolio quality are more important.

You’ll Do Well Here If You Are


Creative without sacrificing accuracy
Organized enough to manage repetitive, high-volume work
Comfortable improving imperfect source material
Curious about new AI and editing tools
Careful not to create misleading property content
Responsive to deadlines and feedback
Able to work without constant supervision


How to Apply

Submit your résumé and an accessible portfolio or work-sample link.

Your portfolio must include examples from at least two of these areas:


Graphics or edited photographs
AI-edited or virtually furnished rooms
Short-form videos
AI-generated presenter or voice content


The link must work without a password or access request.

Candidates whose experience and portfolio align with the position will receive an email invitation to complete a short pre-recorded video interview.

description:
About Four Seasons

Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world-class employee experience and company culture.

At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.

About the location:

An urban oasis in the heart of the city. Set around a verdant inner courtyard, our hacienda-style Hotel puts the hectic urban hustle of Mexico’s vibrant capital city seemingly on pause, but only for as long as you’d like. Step outside our doors, and you’ll find yourself on the grand boulevard of Paseo de la Reforma, just a short stroll away from Bosque de Chapultepec and the trendy neighbourhoods of Condesa and Polanco. Want to know what makes Mexico City tick? Join us at Fifty Mils, one of the 50 Best Bars of the world, and taste the cocktails that are captivating Mexico City.

Únete a nuestro equipo diverso y talentoso de Four Seasons Hotel Ciudad de México,    

Construido en torno a un idílico jardín con rayos de luz que permite que se refleje el brillo de los colores mexicanos, resaltando cada espacio que permiten un viaje de inspiración descubriendo como interactuar con la naturaleza poniendo en pausa al ruido, con una ubicación privilegiada, sobre el elegante Paseo de la Reforma y a metros del Bosque Chapultepec y del Museo de Arte Moderno. Suites amplias y confortables, el servicio cinco estrellas de siempre y novedades culinarias que no desilusionarán a nadie.    

  

Obtenga más información sobre Four Seasons Hotel Ciudad de México,

Instagram: #fsmexico   

FUNCIONES DEL PUESTO

Ejecución de Marketing y Gestión de Campañas

Apoyar al Director de Relaciones Públicas y Marketing en la ejecución de iniciativas de marketing para todos los restaurantes, bares y experiencias culinarias de la propiedad.

Gestionar la planificación, coordinación y ejecución diaria de campañas de marketing, promociones y activaciones.

Asistir en el desarrollo e implementación de programas promocionales alineados con las necesidades del negocio y las oportunidades estacionales.

Coordinar los cronogramas de marketing y garantizar que todos los entregables de las campañas se completen a tiempo.

Asegurar que los materiales promocionales y recursos de marketing se distribuyan correctamente a través de los canales adecuados.

Relaciones Públicas y Coordinación con Medios

Apoyar la ejecución de iniciativas de relaciones públicas para restaurantes y bares en colaboración con la agencia de relaciones públicas de la propiedad y el Director de Relaciones Públicas y Marketing.

Coordinar visitas de medios, degustaciones, colaboraciones con influencers y oportunidades de prensa.

Asistir en la preparación de materiales de prensa, enfoques editoriales y anuncios relacionados con programas culinarios, ofertas de temporada y nuevos conceptos.

Marketing Digital y Redes Sociales

Gestionar la coordinación diaria de iniciativas de redes sociales y marketing digital para restaurantes y bares.

Apoyar al Gerente de Marketing Digital en la organización de calendarios de contenido y garantizar que los recursos de marketing se entreguen a tiempo para redes sociales, campañas y plataformas digitales.

Asistir al Director de Relaciones Públicas en el desarrollo y coordinación de recursos creativos y materiales para medios pagados, garantizando que se entreguen a tiempo y estén alineados con los cronogramas y requisitos de las plataformas digitales.

Mantener y actualizar todas las plataformas en línea, incluyendo:

Google Business Profile

Yelp

OpenTable

TripAdvisor

Instagram y Facebook

Sitios web independientes de restaurantes como BentoBox

Apoyar al Gerente de Marketing Digital en la coordinación de sesiones fotográficas y el desarrollo de contenido para su uso en redes sociales, sitios web y campañas de marketing.

Operaciones de Marketing y Soporte de Contenidos

Asistir en la creación y distribución de comunicaciones de marketing, incluyendo campañas de correo electrónico y mensajes promocionales.

Apoyar la preparación, revisión y coordinación de menús, materiales de marketing y materiales promocionales en colaboración con el equipo de Operaciones de Alimentos y Bebidas (F&B).

Gestionar cronogramas y logística para sesiones fotográficas y creación de contenido que apoyen las iniciativas continuas de marketing.

Experiencia

Entre 3 y 5 años o más de experiencia en marketing, comunicaciones o relaciones públicas dentro de la industria hotelera, restaurantera o marcas de estilo de vida.

Se prefiere fuertemente experiencia previa en marketing de restaurantes u hospitalidad.

Sólido conocimiento de plataformas de marketing digital, redes sociales y herramientas de gestión de reputación en línea.

Excelentes habilidades de redacción, corrección de estilo y comunicación.

Alta capacidad de organización y habilidad para gestionar múltiples proyectos simultáneamente.

Orientación al detalle y comodidad para trabajar en un entorno dinámico y de ritmo acelerado dentro de la industria de la hospitalidad.

Fuertes habilidades de colaboración con equipos multifuncionales, incluyendo operaciones, gastronomía y marketing.

Comprender y familiarizarse con los estándares de calidad y los estándares de servicio del hotel.

Acerca de Four Seasons Hotels & Resorts:   

Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts abrió su primer hotel en 1961 y su historia es una historia de innovación continua, expansión notable y una dedicación decidida a los más altos estándares. Durante casi 50 años, Four Seasons ha transformado la industria de la hospitalidad al combinar amabilidad y eficiencia con las mejores tradiciones hoteleras internacionales. description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

 

About the role:

Have you built something with AI that changed how your team works? Maybe it's an agentic workflow that runs a process from start to finish, or an automation that fixed an operational problem nobody else could solve. We're looking for a senior builder who already works this way and is ready to do it at scale. You'll own projects in our AI-native knowledge framework. You'll work with subject matter experts and peers to create customer documentation and to design the systems that produce it. Experience in technical writing or content development helps, but your track record of building with AI matters most.



You should apply if:

You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-caliber team that will encourage you to do your best. 

Learn more about what we value at Samsara.

In this role, you will:

Design and build AI-powered workflows that change how we create, review, and maintain knowledge content. Examples include agentic pipelines that draft articles from product release information, or automations that flag outdated content.
Find operational problems across the knowledge program and solve them with AI, from intake and routing to quality checks and SME review.
Own projects on the content operations roadmap from scoping through delivery, including timelines, dependencies, and stakeholder updates.
Set and improve the processes and standards the team uses to develop knowledge, and make sure they work well with our AI tools.
Track KPIs on how well our knowledge content performs, share what you learn, and use the data to decide what to build or fix next.
Work with subject matter experts and peers to create and maintain accurate customer documentation.

Minimum requirements for this role:

Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
6+ years of professional experience in operations, program management, knowledge management, technical writing, content development, learning and development, or a related field
Hands-on experience building AI solutions to operational problems, such as agentic workflows, multi-step automations, or AI tools connected to other systems. You can walk us through what you built, why you built it, and what changed as a result
Experience owning projects from start to finish, including scoping, timelines, dependencies, and coordination across teams
Experience creating or maintaining technical content, such as documentation, training materials, or knowledge base articles
A track record of spotting problems and solving them without detailed direction
Clear communication with cross-functional partners and stakeholders at every level

An ideal candidate also has:

Experience connecting AI tools to other systems through APIs, automation platforms, or MCP servers
Experience structuring content so AI systems can retrieve and use it accurately
Proficiency in Jira and experience working in Agile/Scrum environments
Experience with Confluence and Zendesk, or similar knowledge and support platforms
Experience querying data and building dashboards, ideally in Databricks or with SQL
A background in knowledge management or technical writing
 

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

title: Content Writer - Mexico
description:
About North Star Network

North Star Network (NSN) is a global sports and betting media group that builds and operates leading digital brands connecting sports fans and bettors across 30+ countries.

Our mission is to turn passion for sports and gaming into trusted information, data-driven insights, and responsible entertainment.

We’re a multicultural, fully remote company uniting over 50 in-house and 200+ external experts from more than 20 nationalities across Europe, Africa, and the Americas.

About The Role

We are looking for a Content Writer dedicated to the Mexican market.

As a Content Writer, you will be responsible for producing high-quality, accurate, and SEO-driven content tailored to the Mexican audience. Your work will play a key role in attracting, engaging, and converting users across our iGaming and sports platforms.

Reporting to a Content Manager or Senior Content Manager, you will collaborate closely with Editors, SEO specialists, and other Writers to ensure our content meets the highest editorial standards while supporting traffic growth and monetization goals.

This role is ideal for writers who combine strong editorial skills, in-depth knowledge of the Mexican market, and a performance-driven mindset in fast-paced digital environments

Key Responsibilities

Content Creation

Write original, high-quality articles following provided briefs, tone, and structure.

Adapt writing style to match different markets, audiences, and brands.

Ensure factual accuracy and clarity while maintaining an engaging and professional tone.

Produce a consistent volume of content within deadlines, meeting quality and SEO expectations.

Conduct research on relevant topics, trends, and operators to ensure up-to-date and reliable information.

Provide first-person experience and in-depth expertise.

SEO Integration

Apply SEO best practices in writing: use of keywords, internal linking, meta tags, and structured formatting.

Follow content briefs and editorial guidelines to optimize for visibility and conversion.

Collaborate with SEO specialists and Content Managers to adjust existing content when needed.

Track article performance when requested and use feedback to improve writing and targeting.

Review articles on a regular basis to flag outdated information and to implement updates requested from Content Managers.

Collaboration & Feedback

Work closely with Editors and Content Managers to refine drafts and integrate feedback.

Cooperate with other writers to maintain consistent quality and tone across projects.

Participate in content reviews and workshops to improve writing quality and efficiency.

Communicate proactively about challenges, progress, and content ideas.

Compliance & Quality

Ensure all content complies with brand, editorial, and regulatory guidelines, particularly in iGaming and sports-related topics.

Maintain accuracy and neutrality when writing about operators, games, or predictions.

Perform self-proofreading before submission and ensure minimal editing needs.

Keep updated with market regulations, trends, and audience expectations.

What We’re Looking For

Native or near-native Spanish speaker with strong cultural and market knowledge of Mexico

(a must) .

Proven experience as a Content Writer, well versed in sports betting and iGaming

(mandatory) .

Strong writing skills in Mexican Spanish, with the ability to produce clear, persuasive and engaging content.

Solid experience writing SEO-driven content.

Practical knowledge of CMS platforms (e.g. WordPress).

Comfortable working in a remote, multicultural environment.

What We Offer

Work on high-traffic international brands reaching millions of sports fans worldwide.

100% remote work possible.

Join a diverse, international team passionate about sports, content, and digital innovation.

Opportunities to grow within a fast-expanding global media company.

A culture of autonomy, trust, and collaboration.

Competitive Compensation Depending On Experience And Seniority.

Ready to Join Us?

If you’re passionate about sports, content, and iGaming and you want to make an impact in one of Latin America’s key markets we’d love to hear from you.

Apply now and help shape North Star Network’s content strategy across Latin America.

description:
Why YouShift exists

YouShift automates clinical scheduling end-to-end. Admins configure their group's rules once (coverage requirements, fairness constraints, physician contracts, time-off policies) and our engine generates optimized schedules in minutes instead of the days it takes manually. Clinicians submit shift preferences and time-off requests through the app, swap shifts with each other directly, and get visibility into their schedules in real time.

We're now expanding into labor cost intelligence, giving health system leaders direct line of sight into what their workforce is actually costing them, where the leaks are (locums, overtime, unfilled shifts), and how to fix them. Our customers are clinical leaders (CMOs, COOs, VPs of Workforce) and they're trusting us with one of their hardest operational problems.

The role

title: Account Manager - GBS
description:
Responsibilities
TikTok's Global Business Solutions (GBS) regional sales and advertising teams drive revenue growth by promoting our advertising solutions, onboarding clients, and running campaigns that deliver measurable results.

Client needs, market trends, and performance expectations shift constantly, and differently in every market. We build strategy accordingly, turning those moving pieces into advertising solutions that work and client partnerships that last.

You will help businesses grow on a global platform, working on the campaigns and relationships that turn advertisers into long-term partners.

The GBS team at TikTok partners with leading advertisers to drive strategic business growth through innovative and effective marketing solutions. As TikTok Shop continues to scale in the region, our team plays a key role in helping advertisers unlock long-term value through strong account management, solution excellence, and sustainable growth. We are committed to delivering best-in-class client service, actionable insights, and consultative support to help our clients maximize the value of TikTok Shop Ads.

We are looking for an Account Manager to support the growth and success of TikTok Shop Ads across a portfolio of enterprise and mid-market clients. In this role, you will be responsible for managing and growing post-sale client relationships, driving product adoption, and helping advertisers achieve their business and marketing objectives through data-driven and consultative solutions.

You will serve as a trusted partner to clients and work closely with Sales, Product Marketing, Product, Measurement, and TikTok Shop cross-functional teams to deliver strong campaign performance, solve client challenges, and identify sustainable growth opportunities within existing accounts. Success in this role requires a strong client service mindset, commercial acumen, analytical problem-solving, and the ability to thrive in a dynamic and fast-paced environment.

Responsibilities
- Manage and grow post-sale client relationships across a portfolio of enterprise and mid-market accounts, with a focus on retention, product adoption, and long-term business growth.
- Act as a trusted advisor to advertisers by providing strategic guidance on TikTok Shop Ads solutions, campaign setup, optimization, and performance improvement.
- Monitor, analyze, and interpret campaign and business performance data to deliver actionable insights and recommendations that help clients achieve stronger commerce outcomes.
- Drive client education on product capabilities, best practices, measurement solutions, and relevant company updates to improve advertiser effectiveness and adoption.
- Identify upsell, cross-sell, and scaling opportunities within existing accounts, and partner closely with the sales team to unlock incremental revenue growth.
- Conduct regular business reviews and build consultative, long-term relationships with clients by aligning on performance priorities, growth opportunities, and activation plans.
- Partner with Product, Measurement, Product Marketing, and TikTok Shop teams to troubleshoot campaign issues, improve delivery quality, and ensure effective cross-functional support for clients.
- Capture and communicate market feedback, client pain points, and product opportunities to internal stakeholders in order to influence product improvement and go-to-market strategies.
- Act as a subject matter expert in TikTok Shop Ads and commerce media solutions, contributing to internal knowledge sharing, case studies, and capability building across teams.
- Maintain operational excellence in campaign management, execution follow-up, and client servicing while managing multiple priorities in a fast-evolving environment.

Qualifications
Minimum Qualifications
- 4+ years of experience in account management, client services, customer success, or digital marketing roles.
- Proven experience managing key advertiser relationships and driving post-sale account growth in digital advertising, eCommerce, or media environments.
- Strong understanding of performance marketing, the eCommerce ecosystem, and auction-based advertising or retail media models.
- Demonstrated ability to analyze campaign performance and translate data into business insights and strategic recommendations.
- Excellent communication, client management, and presentation skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders.
- English proficiency is required because the role involves frequent communication with global teams and stakeholders across global markets.

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience working with commerce or marketplace platforms (e.g., Amazon, Mercado Livre, Shopee, etc.).
- Experience supporting or managing performance-based advertising products and campaign optimization.
- Strong analytical skills, including advanced Excel capabilities; SQL knowledge is a plus.
- A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset with the ability to navigate ambiguity and identify opportunities for improvement.
- Strong organizational skills and the ability to prioritize effectively in a fast-paced environment while maintaining attention to detail.
- Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams such as Product, Marketing, Analytics, and Measurement.

*Please submit your resume in English.*

About TikTok
TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.​


Why Join Us
Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.​
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.​
​
Diversity & Inclusion​
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.​


TikTok Accommodation
TikTok is committed to providing reasonable accommodations in our recruitment processes for candidates with disabilities, pregnancy, sincerely held religious beliefs or other reasons protected by applicable laws. If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation, please reach out to us at https://tinyurl.com/RA-request​

description:

At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

As the primary technical interface for your accounts, you will foster cross-functional collaboration with our Sales, Support, and Product teams to champion your customers' needs. Our Commitment to Authenticity

The Role

Technical Service Engineers are experts in the entire MongoDB ecosystem - database server, drivers, cloud and infrastructure. This also includes services such as Atlas (database as a service), or Cloud Manager (which helps customers with automation, backup and monitoring of their MongoDB systems). Our engineers combine their MongoDB expertise with passion, initiative, teamwork and a great sense of humor to help our customers to be successful with MongoDB.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Mexico for our hybrid working model.

You’ll bring strong SQL (and/or NOSQL) and database fundamentals, a practical approach to technical problem-solving, and genuine curiosity about the trade-offs between performance and cost. Strong SQL and hands-on experience diagnosing analytical database workloads, including interpreting query plans and investigating performance issues

Lead customers through production incidents end to end: triage, recovery planning, live communication, and post-incident root cause analysis
